class VIPModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim=1024):
        super().__init__()
        self.convnet = models.resnet50(weights=None)
        self.convnet.fc = nn.Linear(2048, hidden_dim)
        self.normlayer = transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
    def forward(self, obs):
        if obs.shape[2:] != (224, 224):
            obs = transforms.Resize(256)(obs)
            obs = transforms.CenterCrop(224)(obs)
        if torch.max(obs) > 2.0:
            obs = obs.float() / 255.0
        obs = self.normlayer(obs)
        return self.convnet(obs)

def load_vip(device):
    vip_path = '/root/.vip/resnet50/model.pt'
    model = VIPModel(hidden_dim=1024)
    model = nn.DataParallel(model)

        emb = model(batch)

    train_X = train_X[perm]
    train_Y = train_Y[perm]
    
    train_ds = TensorDataset(train_X, train_Y)
    train_dl = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True)
    
    model = ProgressMLP(input_dim=1024).to(DEVICE)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
    
    best_val_loss = float('inf')
    best_epoch = 0
    best_state = None
    patience_counter = 0
    
    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        train_loss = 0
        n_batches = 0
        for xb, yb in train_dl:
            xb, yb = xb.to(DEVICE), yb.to(DEVICE)
            pred = model(xb).squeeze(-1)
            loss = criterion(pred, yb)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            train_loss += loss.item()
            n_batches += 1
        train_loss /= n_batches
        
        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_pred = model(val_X.to(DEVICE)).squeeze(-1).cpu()
            val_loss = criterion(val_pred, val_Y).item()
        
        if val_loss < best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = val_loss
            best_epoch = epoch + 1

            patience_counter = 0

            print(f"  Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

    model.eval()

    all_test_true = []
